title: Paid-Resend Rate Uplift Schedule for Mobile Wallet Resends
content:
**Mobile Wallet** resends that the customer has paid for convert at a better rate.

**Uplift rule.** The paid-resend uplift follows the resend charge booked for this resend, that is the resend-charge entry whose sequence number is this resend's number (the number of credits already sent on the transfer). The lines are read in order and the first that holds decides:

| Resend charge booked for this resend | Paid-resend uplift |
|---|---|
| at least the tier's retry fee | 0.20 points |
| above 0.00 and below the tier's retry fee | 0.10 points |
| 0.00, or no charge booked | nothing |

The tier's retry fee is the threshold of the first line:

| Tier | Retry fee (USD) |
|---|---|
| Mobile Wallet Micro | 0.99 |
| Mobile Wallet Economy | 1.99 |
| Mobile Wallet Express | 2.99 |
| Mobile Wallet Express Plus | 0.00 |
| Mobile Wallet Priority | 0.00 |
| Mobile Wallet Large Amount | 4.99 |

On a tier whose retry fee is 0.00, any charge for the resend, including 0.00 or none, is at least the retry fee, so the first line holds and the uplift is 0.20 points.

## Hypothetical cases
- Mobile Wallet Economy, resend number 2, resend-charge entry number 2 of 1.99: at least 1.99, so 0.20 points.
- Mobile Wallet Economy, resend number 2, resend-charge entry number 2 of 1.20: above 0.00 and below 1.99, so 0.10 points.
- Mobile Wallet Micro, resend number 1 with no resend-charge entry numbered 1: nothing.
- Mobile Wallet Large Amount, a resend-charge entry numbered 1 exists but this resend is number 2 and no entry numbered 2 stands: the charge for this resend is none, so nothing.
